newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Dyersburg, Tenn..

text.p: Notice is hereby given that the City of Dyersburg,

on an all or none basis, until 10:30 o'clock, a.m., Central Daylight Savings Time, on Tuesday,

at City Hall, 425 West Court, Dyersburg, Tennessee. The sale may be postponed upon notice given by Munifacts News Wire. If a postponement occurs, the sale will be held at the time and date announced via Munifacts News Wire at least forty- eight hours before the sale. The Bonds will be issued in book entry form, will be dated April 1, 1997, will mature serially on February 1 in the years 1999 through 2012, inclusive, and will bear interest payable semiannually on February 1 and August 1, commencing August 1, 1997. The Municipality has designated the Bonds as qualified tax-exempt obligations '' o Section 265(b)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended. The Bonds maturing on February 1, 1999, through February 1, 2007, are not subject to redemption prior to maturity. The Bonds maturing on and after February 1, 2008, are subject to redemption prior to maturity at the redemption prices and in the manner provided in the Detailed Notice of Sale. Bidders are requested to name the interest rate or rates the Bonds are to bear in multiples of one-eighths (1/8) or one-twentieth (1/20) of one percent (1%) but not exceeding seven and one-half percent (7.50%) per annum. The rate of interest specified for the Bonds of any maturity may not be lower than the rate of interest specified for the Bonds of any preceding maturity. No bid will be considered for less than ninety-eight percent (98%) of par plus accrued interest for all of the Bonds. Unless all bids are rejected, the Bonds will be awarded on the sale date to the bidder whose bid complies with the Detailed Notice of Sale and results in the lowest true interest rate to be calculated as set forth in the Detailed Notice of Sale. The Bonds and approving opinion of Stokes & Bartholomew, P.A., Nashville, Tennessee, will be furnished at the expense of the Municipality. Additional information, including the Official Statement and Detailed Notice of Sale, may be obtained from the undersigned at the City Hall, Dyersburg, Tennessee 38025, or from the Municipality's financial
advisor, SunTrust Capital Markets, Inc., telephone (615) 748-4848.
